leah (sales): Hey team — Acme POC kicks off tomorrow. Need a hosted API key we can rotate daily and revoke at EOD of the trial. Also need IP allowlist + audit logs. @marco can you provision?

marco (solutions): Yup. Hosted keys are easiest for POC. Two options: short-lived keys (recommended) or long-lived + automated rotation. IP allowlist is supported per-key. Quick steps: 
1) Console: Projects > Keys > Create key > Name, expiry, IP allowlist
2) API: POST /v1/keys create

marco (solutions): Example (create key via API):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_ADMIN" \ 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
 -d '{"name":"acme-poc-1","expires_at":"2025-03-10T00:00:00Z","ip_allowlist":["3.4.5.6/32"]}'
```

marco (solutions): Response includes key_id and the secret (shown once). Advise storing secret in customer's vault. You can also attach rotation_policy":{"interval":"24h"} to enable automatic rotations.

dina (security): A couple notes: we surface key creates/rotations/revokes in Audit Logs (console + event stream). For this customer we'll keep logs 365d. Confirm whether Acme's IPs are stable — if not, we can use broader CIDRs or require VPN. Also we need proof of revocation when POC ends.

acme-poc-contact: Does the SDK support auto-refresh so we don't have to implement rotation ourselves?

marco (solutions): Yes — SDK supports token refresh for hosted short-lived keys. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/auth-refresh. Minimal refresh loop example: 

```
# rotation cron (example)
0 */24 * * * /usr/local/bin/rw-rotate --key-id=kj_abc123 --notify=ops@example.com
```
deploy-bot: key created: key_id=kj_abc123, created_by=marco, expires=2025-03-10T00:00:00Z :thumbsup:

leah (sales): Nice. How do we revoke immediately at POC end?

marco (solutions): Revoke with API or console. API example: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/kj_abc123/revoke \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_ADMIN"
```

marco (solutions): API returns 204 on success. Console -> Projects > Keys -> Revoke also works (UI shows revocation audit entry).

dina (security): We'll mark this key in our internal tracker and run an access review on day 0 and day 7. @leah please confirm if Acme wants a migration path to Dedicated creds (they asked about Dedicated pools).

leah (sales): For now they want hosted. If they convert later we can map keys to dedicated pool roles and rotate to service-account-backed keys. I'll confirm with them today.

acme-poc-contact: Thanks — can you DM the SDK sample and rotation cron? We'll test on staging this afternoon.

marco (solutions): Will DM the sample and add this to the POC playbook. :white_check_mark:"
